name: Ashnod
description: Fallaji who used the Staff of Zegon to weaken Urza's automaton.

description_citations.text: "Warlord of Kroog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Zegon, Mishra meets Ashnod, who shows him the Staff of Zegon, and he takes her as apprentice.
timeline.quote: enough to take her on as an apprentice

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.
timeline.quote: the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an "empire"

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so she will protect Kayla.
timeline.quote: Ashnod was let free by Tawnos

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Ashnod to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting; civil war breaks out after the Fall of Sumifa.
timeline.quote: although civil war eventually broke out after the Fall of Sumifa

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod enters Mishra's camp, gives him an artifact and they kiss.
timeline.quote: Ashnod gives him a powerful artifact she has created herself and admits to being attracted to power.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Korlis conference the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces with ornithopters; open conflict erupts; Ashnod kills Urza's patron, and Urza's Mightstone bests Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.
timeline.quote: Fleeing, Mishra curses Urza and his house.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
timeline.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp to negotiate for Zegon and becomes his apprentice and lover; Zegon submits to the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra, his interest piqued, studied the staff, and they agreed she would become his apprentice. They also became lovers.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir kills the Warlord of Kroog, and Ashnod weakens Urza's automaton to free the Qadir before the Fallaji flee.
timeline.quote: Ashnod used her Staff of Zegon to weaken it, forcing it to release the Qadir.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and Ashnod kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat.
timeline.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod develops transmogrants and is made general of a campaign to conquer Korlis, to the dismay of Fallaji war captains.
timeline.quote: Ashnod developed a method for creating transmogrants , artificial zombies

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Korlisian army destroys the transmogrants, Ashnod retreats to Mishra's Fortress and is sent to Sarinth.
timeline.quote: the transmogrants were all destroyed, and Ashnod had to retreat.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod wounds and captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains, takes the sylex and interrogates her in Almaaz.
timeline.quote: Near the Colekgan Mountains , Ashnod wounded and captured Loran, and relieved her of the sylex.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran escapes in 57 AR without the Sylex, and Ashnod follows Mishra to Argoth.
timeline.quote: Ashnod decided to follow him there.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod survives the blast, changes her appearance and name, and by 80 AR founds the Conclave of Mages with Tawnos as Nod.
timeline.quote: she had founded a school of mages and artificers near Ronom Lake with Tawnos.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
timeline.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra journeys to Phyrexia and returns changed, darker and more dangerous.
timeline.quote: Whatever the interpretation, it is plain that Mishra's character changes drastically at this point, becoming darker and more dangerous.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod cross into Phyrexia through a gate the Weakstone opened in the cave of Koilos.
timeline.quote: we are told earlier that Mishra and Ashnod crossed over into the world of Phyrexia through a gate that the Weakstone opened for them in the cave of Koilos

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon sends Loran away with the Golgothian Sylex since his lame leg would slow her; she is captured by Ashnod and tortured.
timeline.quote: Loran did as she was bid, but she was captured by Ashnod who tortured her

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After ten years Loran escapes (or is let go) and finds Feldon; they marry and live near Ronom Glacier.
timeline.quote: Loran tracked down Feldon in his home by the glacier, and they were married.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "After the Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod makes a counterfeit sylex as a decoy that fools the Brotherhood of Gix.
timeline.quote: This cylix was used to fool the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran flees Terisia City with the Sylex, but is later wounded, captured and relieved of it by Ashnod.
timeline.quote: She was later wounded, captured, and relieved of the sylex by Ashnod .

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Terisia City, Loran escapes with the Sylex but is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captures her.
timeline.quote: The avalanche had been triggered by Ashnod, who discovered the Sylex and took both it and Loran into captivity.

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon rescues Loran after several years.
timeline.quote: After several years, Feldon found and rescued Loran

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza finds Kayla with Mishra, negotiations collapse and war is declared; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra ascends as Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra would then ascend as Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Opposing sides of war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir promotes Mishra to raki and they set out to unify the Fallaji; Mishra meets Ashnod.
timeline.quote: promoted Mishra from rakiq to raki

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Urza away hunting him, Mishra attacks Kroog; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra becomes leader of the Fallaji and the Butcher of Kroog.
timeline.quote: Ashnod killed the Qadir, leading to Mishra succeeding him as leader of the Fallaji

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix becomes Mishra's council, banishes Ashnod and helps take Terisia City.
timeline.quote: they became Mishra's council

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos while she holds Gix back.
timeline.quote: They were attacked by Gix , but Ashnod passed the Sylex to Tawnos

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos and Ashnod found the Conclave of Mages near Ronom Lake.
timeline.quote: By 80 AR, he had reconnected with Ashnod

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Both brothers court Ashnod and suffer a final cataclysmic quarrel, parting forever.
timeline.quote: they had a final cataclysmic quarrel and parted ways forever.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza allies with Kroog and spreads influence over Yotia while Mishra works the west and Zegon, where Ashnod joins him as a harsh overlord.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Ashnod joined him, but what a different Ashnod she was!

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod are almost certainly killed, while Urza and Tawnos disappear, perhaps by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod were almost certainly killed in the conflagration, but no concrete evidence exists of this.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod finds few willing to trade their humanity for her power.
timeline.quote: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

citation.text: Ashnod's Transmogrant (Chronicles, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources is recalled.
timeline.quote: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

citation.text: Ashnod's Cylix (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War scarred the land, and Ashnod marked bloodlines.
timeline.quote: The Brothers' War scarred the land, but Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

citation.text: Ashnod's Altar (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod finds few willing to trade humanity for power.
timeline.quote: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered.

citation.text: Ashnod's Transmogrant (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante in Fallaji weapons development.
timeline.quote: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War.

citation.text: Ashnod (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mishra takes Ashnod as apprentice.
timeline.quote: Mishra takes on an apprentice in Ashnod

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod find a portal to Phyrexia in Koilos and are attacked by the demon Gix, then close the portal.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod escape and close the portal.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra conquers Sarinth while Urza annexes Korlis and Sardia, and Ashnod obtains the Golgothian Sylex at Terisia City.
timeline.quote: Ashnod obtains a Thran artifact called the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
timeline.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War scarred the land and Ashnod marked bloodlines.
timeline.quote: Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

citation.text: Ashnod's Altar (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
timeline.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashnod reports a breakthrough in liquimetal coating on the fifth iteration.
timeline.quote: "We've had a breakthrough on the fifth iteration.

citation.text: Liquimetal Coating (The Brothers' War Retro Artifacts, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod tells Tawnos to get the sylex to Urza at any cost.
timeline.quote: "Get the sylex to Urza at any cost.

citation.text: Fateful Handoff (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with Ashnod, reactivates the portal, steps into Phyrexia and brings back three dragon engines but is discovered by Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra charmed three dragon engines and brought them back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After ten years of siege, Sarinth falls to Ashnod's forces and is forced into the Fallaji army.
timeline.quote: after ten years of siege, Sarinth is overtaken by Ashnod's forces and forced into the Fallaji army.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod helps the captured Tawnos escape; the Brotherhood of Gix persuades Mishra to banish her.
timeline.quote: The Brotherhood of Gix discovers this and persuades Mishra to banish her.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains and takes the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Loran is captured by Ashnod near the Colekgan Mountains.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
timeline.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon on condition she protect the pregnant queen.
timeline.quote: was let free by Tawnos and given the Staff of Zegon back on the premise that she protected the pregnant queen.

citation.text: "Fall of Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod knocks out the Qadir's guards and kills the Qadir by draining his life with the staff.
timeline.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

citation.text: "Fall of Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat and returns to Mishra.
timeline.quote: Ashnod then made sure Tawnos and Kayla escaped the burning city in a boat headed downriver towards the sea

citation.text: "Fall of Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran is later captured by Ashnod, who takes the Sylex but keeps it from Mishra.
timeline.quote: she was later captured by Ashnod

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hajar accompanies Mishra to Argoth, but Ashnod displaces him as closest to Mishra and arranges for him and Gwenna to board a ship, so he misses the Battle at Argoth and the Sylex Blast.
timeline.quote: Ashnod arranged for Hajar and Gwenna to board a ship for the mainland

citation.text: "Hajar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's avenger chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it; Urza's Mightstone and Mishra's Weakstone overload it and it explodes.
timeline.quote: The opposite forces overloaded the Avenger, making it explode.

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji flee across the Kher Ridges, harassed by ornithopters and ground troops.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji fled across the Kher Ridges

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod lures Tawnos away while Kayla gets Urza drunk, steals the Mightstone, delivers it to Mishra and sleeps with him.
timeline.quote: She then went to Mishra's quarters, delivered the stone to him, and slept with him.

citation.text: "Peace Talks at Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza confronts Mishra and the stones battle; Urza lowers his stone and Mishra zaps him with the Weakstone and leaves, the Fallaji withdraw, and Ashnod is taken prisoner.
timeline.quote: This allowed Mishra to zap him with the Weakstone and barge out.

citation.text: "Peace Talks at Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After banishing Ashnod, Mishra, listening to the Brotherhood of Gix, becomes inclined to raze Terisia City.
timeline.quote: Mishra became inclined to raze Terisia City

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it with the Staff of Zegon; Mishra's Weakstone makes it explode and the Fallaji flee.
timeline.quote: Mishra used the Weakstone , overloading it and making it explode

citation.text: "Warlord of Kroog", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ashnod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: He had a deep hatred for Ashnod

citation.text: "Farid", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: he developed a romantic interest in Ashnod
